free_tier.stated: Apache-2.0 open-source software with no licence fee and no metered quota: the user downloads and runs a server and at least one agent on a machine the user provides. The Test Drive is a local, download-and-run evaluation instance, not a hosted service
free_tier.notes: there is no hosted lane to denominate; the only cost is the machine the user runs the server and agents on

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: there is no hosted service to impose a single-object cap; pipeline and artifact limits are set by the user's own server configuration

retention.stated: whatever the machine running the GoCD server and agents retains; the software imposes no fixed retention period

egress.terms: whatever the machine running the GoCD server and agents charges for outbound traffic; the software meters and caps no traffic itself

interface_detail: a material is usually a source repository (Git, SVN, Mercurial) that the server polls for commits, and a timer or pipeline dependency can also trigger a run. A REST API at go-server-url:8154/go/api reads configuration and build history and can update configuration and execute builds; the API reference offers Shell bindings and curl examples
endpoint: https://go-server-url:8154/go/api (the host is the user's own server)
tooling: the user installs and runs the GoCD Server and one or more GoCD Agent daemons on a rented or free machine, from OS installers, Zip archives, Docker images or a Kubernetes Helm chart; the agent polls the server for work and executes the build tasks
chaining: no hosted runner lane exists: the Test Drive is a local download-and-run evaluation instance, described as for evaluation purposes only and not for production. The self-hosted server and agents are the last resort; pair them with a free or rented machine. Pipelines can be triggered by Git commits, a timer or an upstream pipeline, and driven through the REST API

limits.value: no hosted tier exists, so the path is a self-hosted deployment of a server plus at least one agent

binding_note: the binding constraint is the need to install and operate a server and agent on a machine the user provides, since the vendor offers no hosted runner that could be used instead

identity_cost.detail: the software downloads and runs with no account: the download page links installers and images directly with no sign-up, and a newly installed GoCD server does not require users to authenticate. Optional password-file or LDAP/AD authentication is configured locally by the operator; the Test Drive is a local installer needing no registration

reliability_note: the host, its bill and its uptime belong to whoever runs the instance, so no reliability event at a provider applies to this record; the Test Drive is explicitly for evaluation, not production use
